"""RoboLab rcb-limited/2.0 episode controller and record."""
import json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
RUNS = pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
print('CONNECTED; SPEC:', json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
obs = r.get_obs(video='frames')
obs.save(str(RUNS / '000_initial'))
print('INITIAL OBS SAVED', obs.meta, flush=True)

_chunk = 0
def observe(seconds=0.0, video='both'):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    obs.save(str(RUNS / f'{_chunk:03d}_observe'))
    print('OBS', obs.meta, 'proprio=', obs.proprio, flush=True)
    return obs

def act(kind, actions, dt=1/15, note=''):
    global obs, _chunk
    _chunk += 1
    res = r.submit(kind, np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video='both', note=note)
    res.save(str(RUNS / f'{_chunk:03d}_{note or kind}'))
    obs = res
    print('RESULT', _chunk, res.meta, 'proprio_shape=', None if res.proprio is None else res.proprio.shape, flush=True)
    return res

def ee(x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,g, note='ee'):
    return act('ee_pose', [[x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,g]], note=note)

def jp(q, gripper, dt=0.2, note='joint'):
    return act('joint_position', [list(q)+[gripper]], dt=dt, note=note)

print('READY for interactive control; r, spec, obs, act(), ee(), observe() are available.', flush=True)

"""RoboLab rcb-limited/2.0 episode controller and record."""
import json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
RUNS = pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
print('CONNECTED; SPEC:', json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
obs = r.get_obs(video='frames')
obs.save(str(RUNS / '000_initial'))
print('INITIAL OBS SAVED', obs.meta, flush=True)

_chunk = 0
def observe(seconds=0.0, video='both'):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    obs.save(str(RUNS / f'{_chunk:03d}_observe'))
    print('OBS', obs.meta, 'proprio=', obs.proprio, flush=True)
    return obs

def act(kind, actions, dt=1/15, note=''):
    global obs, _chunk
    _chunk += 1
    res = r.submit(kind, np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video='both', note=note)
    res.save(str(RUNS / f'{_chunk:03d}_{note or kind}'))
    obs = res
    print('RESULT', _chunk, res.meta, 'proprio_shape=', None if res.proprio is None else res.proprio.shape, flush=True)
    return res

def ee(x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,g, note='ee'):
    return act('ee_pose', [[x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,g]], note=note)

def jp(q, gripper, dt=0.2, note='joint'):
    return act('joint_position', [list(q)+[gripper]], dt=dt, note=note)

print('READY for interactive control; r, spec, obs, act(), ee(), observe() are available.', flush=True)
